messages:
anya: quick heads-up  noticed ~80 leads land in SF with owner=null last night. pattern points to enrichment finishing after RR runs.
kevin: same race we've seen before. do we have a reproducible example?
zoe: grabbed one from proxy: {hs_id: 2233, email: lead+eu@comp.io, state: enriching, recv_ts: 3180000000} then enrichment_ready at 3180000018 but SF record created at 3180000005 with owner=null.
anya: idea: implement a tiny "claim_lease" flow so RR writes owner_lease_id into SF on tentative claim. finalizer only sets owner if owner_lease_id matches.
kevin: agree. TTL 75s on lease. if lease expires, route to backlog@ops instead of leaving owner null.
zoe: canary plan: 5% EU leads for 3 hours. emit metrics: lease_fallback_count and lease_mismatch_count. alert lease_fallback_count > 2% over 15m -> notify channel; >8% -> page.
anya: quick patch: bump enrichment TTL to 90s while we add lease. reduces races short-term.
kevin: i'll coordinate with sales-ops to add owner_lease_c custom field in SF. verify no workflows will touch it.
zoe: PRs: "hs-proxy: expose owner_lease_id" and "assigner: tentative-lease-write + backlog-fallback". estimated 1.5-2h to ship both to canary.
ops-bot: replay job queued: replay_318000 status=queued
anya: action list: zoe ships TTL bump + proxy change, kevin updates assigner & coordinates SF field, i'll configure alerts and run replay backfill after reconciler runs. target: canary by lunchtime.
kevin: one more: add a reconciler job to sweep SF contacts created in last 2h with owner=null and re-run assigner. low-risk backfill.
zoe: starting the canary rollout to 5% EU now. will post a metric snapshot in 20m. :hourglass:
